name: com.nakamafarsi.unity
description: Nakama Unity client (Heroic Labs) with the nakama-farsi layer built in: session and socket management, socket-first RPCs with HTTP fallback, typed wrappers for every nakama-farsi RPC, phone login, coins, web gateways, Cafe Bazaar and Myket billing, leaderboards, tasks, chat and stickers. Includes the Police Patrol layer (PolicePatrol.Sdk, the API of com.policepatrol.sdk 0.5.x to 0.7.0), switched on by the POLICEPATROL_SDK symbol.

samples.description: Device login, socket, first reads, phone login.
Catalog, coins, Cafe Bazaar or Myket (test store in sandbox) and ZarinPal with the return to the game.
Device login and a first authenticated call (PolicePatrolQuickStart).
ZarrinPal checkout with the deep link return, and Bazaar / Myket billing with the developer payload.
One component, no scene setup: device login, balances, the shop list and a test store that buys against the server sandbox.
Context, design events with a hierarchy, progression and resource events, and legacy stats.
Stage attempts with the result saved before sending: the saved result is sent before a new attempt starts, retried on network errors and kept when the server owns the stage.
